title: Price Prediction: ON Semiconductor Stock Looks Ready for Its Next Move
excerpt: ON Semiconductor has pulled back sharply while its AI data center business accelerates toward a potential doubling, so the real question is whether the sello...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • ON Semiconductor earns a BUY at a $115 price target, representing 43% upside, as AI data center revenue doubles in 2026 and free cash flow quadruples.

  • Texas Instruments grew Q2 revenue 23% and Microchip commands a premium valuation on lower sales, both validating the recovery multiple embedded in ON's $115 target.

  • Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Our call on ON Semiconductor (NASDAQ:ON) is straightforward. The 24/7 Wall St. price target for onsemi is $115.02, pointing to 43.05% upside from the current $80.40 quote. Our recommendation is buy, with a 90% confidence level.

A quadrupling in free cash flow, an AI data center business set to more than double this year, and a fresh $6 billion buyback authorization make the risk/reward attractive after the recent pullback.

24/7 Wall St. Price Target Summary

From Cyclical Trough to AI Reacceleration

Shares have cooled recently, sliding 9.7% in the past week and 11.86% over the past month, yet ON is still up 48.48% year to date and 41.5% over the past year. The stock sits 16% below its 52-week high of $134.92, well off the $44.56 low set during the analog cycle bottom.

Q2 2026, filed August 3, 2026, delivered clean results. Non-GAAP EPS of $0.74 beat the $0.72 consensus, revenue of $1.60 billion grew 9.2% year over year, and Power Solutions Group revenue rose 19% to $829 million.

Free cash flow of $425.4 million was roughly quadruple the year-ago figure. CEO Hassane El-Khoury told investors "AI data center remains our fastest-growing business, and we now expect revenue to more than double in 2026."

Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Why Bulls See a Breakout Ahead

Management guided Q3 revenue to $1.65 billion to $1.75 billion and non-GAAP EPS to $0.81 to $0.93, both above trailing quarters. The AI data center thesis has real receipts: expanding NVIDIA MGX ecosystem wins, a strategic EliteSiC and silicon MOSFET platform deal with Great Wall, and the new GaNEXUS gallium nitride portfolio spanning 40V to 650V.

Automotive momentum layers on top, with 900V EV architecture wins at Geely and NIO plus the Rivian R2 zonal architecture. In the bull case, ON reaches $127.69 within twelve months, roughly 58.81% upside. Analyst consensus of $113.12 sits in that neighborhood, backed by 11 Buy ratings against zero Sells.

快速阅读

  • 安森美半导体获得买入评级，目标价为 115 美元，上涨空间为 43%，因为 2026 年人工智能数据中心收入将翻一番，自由现金流将翻两番。
  • 德州仪器 (Texas Instruments) 第二季度收入增长了 23%，而 Microchip 在销售额下降的情况下获得了溢价估值，两者都验证了 ON 115 美元目标中包含的复苏倍数。
  • 不要等待：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚透露了他最喜欢的 10 只人工智能股票。 立即免费查看完整列表。

我们对安森美半导体（纳斯达克股票代码：ON）的看好很简单。 Onsemi 24/7 华尔街目标价为 115.02 美元，较当前 80.40 美元报价上涨 43.05%。 我们的建议是买入，置信度为 90%。

自由现金流翻了两番，人工智能数据中心业务今年将增长一倍以上，以及新的 60 亿美元回购授权，使得在最近的回调之后风险/回报颇具吸引力。

24/7 华尔街价格目标摘要

从周期性低谷到人工智能再加速

股价最近有所降温，过去一周下跌 9.7%，过去一个月下跌 11.86%，但年初至今仍上涨 48.48%，去年上涨 41.5%。 该股较 52 周高点 134.92 美元低 16%，远低于模拟周期底部期间创下的 44.56 美元低点。

2026 年第二季度，于 2026 年 8 月 3 日提交，交付了干净的结果。 非 GAAP 每股收益为 0.74 美元，超出市场预期 0.72 美元，收入为 16 亿美元，同比增长 9.2%，Power Solutions Group 收入增长 19%，达到 8.29 亿美元。

自由现金流为 4.254 亿美元，大约是去年同期的四倍。 首席执行官 Hassane El-Khoury 告诉投资者：“人工智能数据中心仍然是我们增长最快的业务，我们现在预计 2026 年收入将增加一倍以上。”

不要等待：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚透露了他最喜欢的 10 只人工智能股票。 立即免费查看完整列表。

为什么多头看到未来突破

管理层预计第三季度营收为 16.5 亿美元至 17.5 亿美元，非 GAAP 每股收益为 0.81 美元至 0.93 美元，均高于上一季度。 AI 数据中心论文取得了实际成果：扩大 NVIDIA MGX 生态系统的胜利、与长城达成战略性 EliteSiC 和硅 MOSFET 平台协议，以及涵盖 40V 至 650V 的全新 GaNEXUS 氮化镓产品组合。

汽车动力层层出炉，吉利和蔚来的 900V 电动汽车架构以及 Rivian R2 区域架构获胜。 在牛市情况下，ON 在 12 个月内达到 127.69 美元，上涨幅度约为 58.81%。 分析师一致认为该区间为 113.12 美元，有 11 个买入评级，而 0 个卖出评级为支撑。
